title: 中国政府奖学金 CSC
amount: 全额（学费+住宿+生活费+保险）
summary: 中国政府面向全球留学生的最重要奖学金，覆盖学费、住宿费、生活费和医疗保险，本科 2,500 元/月、硕士 3,000 元/月、博士 3,500 元/月。
summary_en: The most important scholarship for international students from the Chinese government, covering tuition, accommodation, living expenses and medical insurance. Bachelor 2,500 RMB/month, Master 3,000 RMB/month, PhD 3,500 RMB/month.
description: 可通过中国驻外使领馆申请（国别 bilateral 渠道）或直接向目标院校申请（大学渠道）。需提供 HSK 成绩、推荐信、学习成绩单等材料。每年名额超 40,000 个，覆盖 200+ 所中国高校，是来华留学生最主要的全额奖学金来源。
description_en: Can be applied for through Chinese embassies and consulates abroad (bilateral channel) or directly to target universities (university channel). Requires HSK scores, recommendation letters, academic transcripts and other materials. More than 40,000 quotas each year, covering 200+ Chinese universities — the main full scholarship source for international students in China.

title: 孔子学院奖学金
university: 中国国际中文教育基金会
amount: 全额（学费+住宿+生活费+保险）
summary: 面向汉语学习者和国际中文教育教师的专项奖学金，支持攻读汉语国际教育硕士、汉语本科及相关博士专业。
summary_en: A special scholarship for Chinese language learners and international Chinese education teachers, supporting Master's in Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages, Chinese Bachelor's and related PhD programs.
description: 通过全球各地的孔子学院推荐申请，需具备一定 HSK 等级水平。奖学金覆盖学费、住宿费、生活费和医疗保险，是专注于中文和中国文化学习的留学生首选。孔子学院在全球 160+ 国家设有分支机构。
description_en: Apply through Confucius Institutes worldwide, requiring a certain HSK level. The scholarship covers tuition, accommodation, living expenses and medical insurance — the first choice for international students focused on Chinese language and culture. Confucius Institutes have branches in 160+ countries.

title: 北京市外国留学生奖学金
title_en: Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students
summary: 北京市政府设立，吸引优秀留学生来京学习，覆盖北京地区 30+ 所高校，可与其他奖学金叠加申请。
summary_en: Established by the Beijing Municipal Government to attract outstanding international students to study in Beijing, covering 30+ universities in the Beijing area. Can be combined with other scholarships.
description: 面向在京高校就读的留学生，提供部分学费减免。申请需通过就读院校国际学生办公室提交，要求学业成绩优良。北京作为首都，汇聚清华、北大、人大、北师大等顶尖学府，是留学生的热门选择。
description_en: For international students studying at universities in Beijing, providing partial tuition waivers. Apply through the international student office of your university, requiring good academic performance. Beijing, as the capital, gathers top universities such as Tsinghua, Peking, Renmin and BNU — a popular choice for international students.

title: 上海市外国留学生奖学金
title_en: Shanghai Government Scholarship for International Students
summary: 上海市政府设立，支持留学生来沪深造，覆盖复旦、上交、同济、华师大等 20+ 所在沪高校。
summary_en: Established by the Shanghai Municipal Government to support international students studying in Shanghai, covering 20+ universities including Fudan, SJTU, Tongji and ECNU.
description: 分为 A 类（全额）、B 类（部分）两类，申请通过就读院校提交。上海作为国际金融中心，为留学生提供丰富的实习和就业机会，尤其在金融、贸易、航运、互联网等领域。
description_en: Divided into Class A (full) and Class B (partial), applied for through your university. Shanghai, as an international financial center, provides international students with rich internship and employment opportunities, especially in finance, trade, shipping and internet sectors.

title: 江苏省茉莉花奖学金
summary: 江苏省政府设立，吸引优秀留学生来苏学习，覆盖南大、东南、苏大等 20+ 所江苏高校，是中国地方奖学金中规模最大之一。
summary_en: Established by the Jiangsu Provincial Government to attract outstanding international students, covering 20+ universities including Nanjing University, SEU and Soochow University — one of the largest provincial scholarships in China.
description: 提供学费减免和生活费补助，按学业成绩和综合素质评定。江苏经济发达、文化底蕴深厚，南京、苏州、无锡等城市既有千年文脉又是现代产业重镇，深受留学生欢迎。
description_en: Provides tuition waivers and living allowances, evaluated by academic performance and overall quality. Jiangsu has a developed economy and profound cultural heritage — cities like Nanjing, Suzhou and Wuxi combine millennium-old culture with modern industries, popular among international students.

title: 校级新生奖学金（清华/北大等）
summary: 各高校自设的留学生奖学金，清华、北大、复旦、浙大等名校均有专属项目，可与国家级、省市奖学金叠加申请，最高可全额覆盖并结余。
summary_en: University-level scholarships for international students. Top schools like Tsinghua, Peking, Fudan and ZJU all have dedicated programs that can be stacked with national and provincial scholarships — up to full coverage with surplus.
description: 评定标准通常包括学业成绩、语言能力、综合素质等。部分高校还设有专项奖学金支持特定专业（如工程、医学、农学）或特定国家来源的留学生。建议申请时直接向目标院校国际学生办公室咨询具体奖学金项目和申请流程。
description_en: Evaluation criteria typically include academic performance, language proficiency and overall quality. Some universities also offer special scholarships for specific majors (engineering, medicine, agriculture) or students from specific countries. It is recommended to consult the international student office of your target university for specific scholarship programs and application procedures.
